correctness.rationale: Ind2(D) means induced connected components of any selected vertex set have size at most 2, equivalently induced degree≤1 or exclusion of 60 connected triples, not ordinary independence. Independent forbidden-triple enumeration yields 63,142 nonempty faces and explicit facet vector. Reconstructed 31,565 staged face matches, complete acyclicity of 410,500 oriented Hasse covers, and critical cells one0, one5, six6, four7. The signed Morse ∂6=(0,0,-1,0,1,0) has rank1 primitive; the four-column ∂7 lies in its integer kernel and a specified maximal minor is ±1, giving primitive rank4. Homotopy cancels the unique 5-cell and four 6/7 pairs because π5(S5) and π6(wedge S6) classify cell attachments by degrees, leaving S6. Independent Python calculation rebuilt face list/matching/integral Morse matrices, not only stored output. Rotation ρ of order ten fixes no nonempty allowed face (vertex orbits of size10 each induce degree2), so L(ρ)=0 and on H0⊕H6 gives trace H6=-1; powers yield (-1)^t. Only integral homology action, not equivariant sphere equivalence.
